title: Highest point speed
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at the highest point using v = √(gL) or equivalent energy/tension reasoning.

title: Lowest point velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the velocity magnitude at the lowest point when the rope breaks using T_max - mg = mv²/L.

title: Horizontal range
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the horizontal range using projectile motion after the rope breaks.

title: Projectile time calculation
description: Important: Correctly determines the time of flight after the break using vertical free-fall from height (h-L).

title: Tension-force balance
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law correctly at both highest and lowest points of circular motion.

title: Energy conservation reasoning
description: Optional: Uses energy conservation between highest and lowest points as an alternative or check.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in force balance (e.g., T + mg at lowest point) or confuses centripetal force direction.

title: Height misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect vertical drop distance (h instead of h-L) for projectile time calculation.
